download_biranker_dialogue_model: download the pretrained LIGHT BERT bi-Ranker dialogue model to a specified datapath
run_download_function: run the download function to fetch biranker_dialogue.tar.gz from the Parlai model zoo
test_download_function: test the download function by passing a datapath and verifying the model tarball is retrieved
review_download_function: review the download function to understand how it uses download_models with model_type biranker_dialogue
summarize_download_function: summarize the download function which fetches the LIGHT BERT bi-Ranker dialogue model version v0.5
